column1: There are three buttons here. They are marked "AutoNav", "Power", and "Don't Touch".
column2: 這裡有三個按鈕，分別標著「自動導航」、「電源」和「請勿觸碰」。

column1: There are some lights on. They indicate (when lit) that all pod systems are functioning normally.
column2: 有幾盞燈亮著，這些燈亮起時，表示逃生艙所有系統運作正常。

column2: 控制台上的燈目前沒有亮。

column2: 這件事你已經做過了。

column2: 你瘋了嗎？很明顯你根本不知道自己在幹嘛，你這個蠢蛋。

column2: 欸！你在幹嘛？飛行途中不要亂動節流閥！你麻煩已經夠多了，怎麼不花點時間想想要怎麼解決？

column1: Your door is ajar.
column2: 你的艙門沒關緊。

column1: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.
column2: 很抱歉，戴夫，恐怕我沒辦法這麼做。

column1: The throttle is of the usual "T"-shaped variety.
column2: 這根節流閥是常見的「T」字形款式。

column2: 不行，門是關著的。

column2: 不行，你的安全帶還扣著。

column2: 你沒看到什麼特別的東西。

column2: 節流閥目前的位置讓你沒辦法這麼做。

column1: Don't worry. Aside from a stray Sarien attack, this is a low crime area.
column2: 別擔心，除了偶爾有沙利安人來亂之外，這一帶治安算不錯。

column1: The throttle is already in that position.
column2: 節流閥已經在那個位置了。

column1: The door is small and uninteresting. It is presently closed.
column2: 這扇門又小又平凡，目前是關著的。

column1: The door is small and uninteresting. It is presently open.
column2: 這扇門又小又平凡，目前是開著的。

column1: All systems are GO
column2: 所有系統一切正常

column2: 這只是一般的乘客安全束帶裝置。

column1: The throttle is back as far as it will go.
column2: 節流閥已經拉到底了。

column1: You should specify which button you would like to push.
column2: 你該說清楚想按哪個按鈕。

column1: Please remain seated and keep seat belt buckled while vehicle is in motion.
column2: 載具行進中請坐好，並繫緊安全帶。

column1: . . . .WARNING. . . .
Self-Destruct Mechanism Has Been Armed!
column2: 自毀裝置已啟動！

column1: Evacuate Ship Immediately!
column2: 立刻棄船逃生！

column1: !! THIS IS NOT A TEST !!
column2: ！！這不是演習！！

column1: This is the Star Generator development laboratory.  Due to your incredibly low security clearance you have never been allowed access to this room.
column2: 這裡是星辰產生器的研發實驗室。以你低到不行的安全權限，本來根本不可能踏進這間房間。

column1: Through the observation window you can see to infinity.
column2: 透過觀測窗，你可以看到無窮無盡的遠方。

column1: Looking at the console you see many displays and instruments which make no sense to you.  There is a flashing light near a screen in the center.
column2: 你看著控制台，上面一堆顯示器和儀器你完全看不懂。中央的螢幕附近有一盞燈在閃。

column1: There is an empty pedestal here. It looks like it is used to hold some large object, maybe the Star Generator.
column2: 這裡有一座空的底座，看起來是用來放置某個大型物體的，也許就是星辰產生器。

column1: The floor is normal except for two dead bodies and a pedestal in the middle.
column2: 地板看起來沒什麼異狀，只是中間躺著兩具屍體，還有一座底座。

column1: The back wall is barren. The others, as you can see, are actually large windows allowing you an unrestricted view of space.
column2: 後牆光禿禿的什麼都沒有，其他牆面你也看得出來，其實都是大片窗戶，讓你能毫無阻隔地看到外太空。

column1: Hanging from the ceiling is a large device which apparently helped support the item which was mounted on the pedestal below.
column2: 天花板上垂掛著一具大型裝置，看起來是用來支撐底下底座上那件物品的。

column1: That can't be done at this location.
column2: 這個地方沒辦法這麼做。

column1: The sheer vastness of space never ceases to amaze you.
column2: 太空浩瀚無垠的景象，總是讓你嘆為觀止。

column1: Gazing out at the stars reminds you of how far you are from home.
column2: 望著滿天星斗，讓你想起自己離家有多遠。

column1: Peering through the large observation windows you take in the immense panorama of space and stars.
column2: 你透過大片觀測窗，把浩瀚的星空盡收眼底。

column1: Your mind is boggled in attempting to understand the function of the various buttons, switches, lights, and displays. It appears the board is not operating.
column2: 你想搞懂這些按鈕、開關、燈號和顯示器到底是幹嘛用的，但完全一頭霧水。看起來這片面板根本沒在運作。

column1: This console shows the only signs of life. One red light shines from the the upper-left corner of a glowing monitor.
column2: 這座控制台是唯一還有動靜的地方，一盞紅燈從發著光的螢幕左上角亮著。

column1: That console could be better viewed from a closer vantage point.
column2: 這座控制台再靠近一點看會更清楚。

column1: There are many buttons here. Messing with them will not help anything.
column2: 這裡有一堆按鈕，亂按也不會有什麼幫助。

column1: The lights are all out except for one on the other console.
column2: 燈全滅了，只剩另一座控制台上還有一盞亮著。

column1: One light glows red indicating that the monitor power is on.
column2: 有一盞紅燈亮著，表示螢幕的電源是開著的。

column1: There is nothing to see here.
column2: 這裡沒什麼好看的。

column1: That can not be seen from here.
column2: 從這裡看不到那個。

column1: You see sprawled at your feet the lifeless body of another crew member.
column2: 你腳邊倒著另一名船員的屍體。

column1: Yet another body lies motionless.
column2: 又是一具動也不動的屍體。

column1: The reward for your search is. . .
column2: 你搜索的收穫是……

column1: There is no Star Generator here to look at.
column2: 這裡沒有星辰產生器可以看。

column1: Congratulations! You have narrowly escaped an explosive death! Don't start patting yourself on the back just yet, though. You are now traveling aimlessly through the cosmos.
column2: 恭喜！你千鈞一髮逃過一場爆炸死亡！不過先別急著自誇，你現在正在宇宙中漫無目的地漂流。

column1: The Autonav system has locked onto the small planet of Kerona and the pod has begun its approach. Nothing to do now but hang on!
column2: 自動導航系統已經鎖定柯羅娜星這顆小行星，逃生艙已經開始接近。現在你只能抓緊坐穩！

column1: Well done, %s1! You've managed to overcome the elements of Kerona, from endless deserts and spider droids to obnoxious salesmen and bad booze. Yes, the sand in your boots shall forever serve as a reminder of this forsaken planet. You should feel proud. But now, destiny awaits with an even greater challenge.
column2: 做得好，%s1！你撐過了柯羅娜星的種種考驗——無盡的沙漠、蜘蛛機器人、討人厭的推銷員，還有難喝到爆的酒。沒錯，靴子裡的沙子會永遠提醒你這顆被遺忘的星球。你應該為自己感到驕傲。但現在，命運正等著你迎接更大的挑戰。

column1: You are inside the escape pod. It appears that the more fragile devices were damaged severely by the impact of landing.
column2: 你在逃生艙裡，看起來比較脆弱的裝置在降落撞擊中都嚴重損壞了。

column1: Through the window you see a vast wasteland composed of sand.
column2: 透過窗戶，你看到一片由沙子構成的遼闊荒地。

column1: The console consists of a screen, pod status indicators, a throttle, and some buttons.  The buttons are marked "AutoNav" and "Power".
column2: 控制台上有一個螢幕、逃生艙狀態指示燈、一根節流閥，還有幾個按鈕。按鈕分別標著「自動導航」和「電源」。

column1: Pushing the AutoNav button has no effect.
column2: 按下自動導航按鈕沒有任何反應。

column1: The throttle seems to be jammed.  It won't budge.
column2: 節流閥好像卡住了，動也不動。

column1: The screen is dark, not to mention cracked.
column2: 螢幕一片漆黑，而且還裂了。

column1: Pushing the Power button has no effect.
column2: 按下電源按鈕沒有任何反應。

column1: You are inside the escape pod. It appears that the more fragile devices were damaged severely by the impact of landing.  Got any bright ideas, Edison?
column2: 你在逃生艙裡，看起來比較脆弱的裝置在降落撞擊中都嚴重損壞了。有什麼好點子嗎，愛迪生？

column1: You are unable to leave with your seat belt on.
column2: 安全帶還扣著，你沒辦法離開。

column1: Done
column2: 完成

column2: 這件事已經做過了。

column1: You can fix nothing here.
column2: 這裡沒有東西可以修。

column1: Neither this nor anything else on the console works.
column2: 這個和控制台上其他東西都沒有用。

column1: There are three buttons here. They are marked "AutoNav", "Power", and "Don't Press".
column2: 這裡有三個按鈕，分別標著「自動導航」、「電源」和「請勿按下」。

column1: The door has been permanently opened by the impact of landing.
column2: 這扇門在降落撞擊中被撞得永久打開了。

column1: A survival kit has broken loose from someplace.
column2: 一個求生包不知道從哪裡鬆脫，掉了下來。

column1: There is nothing under the seat.
column2: 座位底下什麼都沒有。

column1: After a skull-jarring landing, you peer through the shattered viewing port out onto the desert landscape. A feeling of utter desolation settles in. You`re in a fine mess now, %s1.
column2: 經過一陣天旋地轉的硬著陸後，你從破裂的觀測窗望向外面的沙漠景色，一股徹底的荒涼感湧上心頭。你這下麻煩大了，%s1。

column1: No way.
column2: 沒門。

column1: You are high atop a rocky plateau. The desert below seems to stretch to infinity.
column2: 你站在一座岩石高原頂端，下方的沙漠彷彿無邊無際地延伸出去。

column1: It is merely a spire of rock which has managed to defy the elements.
column2: 這只是一根撐過風吹日曬的岩石尖塔。

column1: You are near the base of a plateau. It is a rather bleak environment.
column2: 你在一座高原的底部附近，這裡的環境相當荒涼。

column1: You are high atop a rocky plateau near two halves of an arch. The desert below seems to stretch to infinity.
column2: 你站在一座岩石高原頂端，附近有一座斷成兩半的拱門，下方的沙漠彷彿無邊無際地延伸出去。

column1: You are near the base of a plateau, upon which rests two large rocks. It is a rather bleak environment.
column2: 你在一座高原的底部附近，上頭擺著兩塊大石頭，這裡的環境相當荒涼。

column1: You see a pair of oddly curved rock formations. They point at each other as if to form an arch.
column2: 你看到一對形狀怪異的彎曲岩層，彼此對望，彷彿要拼成一座拱門。

column1: Near the base you notice some very small printing. If you're not mistaken the characters translate to "497 Quadgillion Served."
column2: 在底部你注意到幾個很小的印刷字。如果你沒看錯，這些字翻譯過來是「已服務 497 垓位顧客。」

column1: From this distance it looks like an ordinary hole in the side of the cliff.  For a better look you will have to get closer.
column2: 從這個距離看，這只是懸崖側面一個普通的洞，想看清楚一點，你得靠近一些。

column1: Whatever is in that hole just enjoyed lunch - on you.  This should teach you to be cautious when encountering alien holes.
column2: 不管那個洞裡是什麼東西，牠剛剛美美地吃了一頓——就是你，這下你該學乖了，遇到外星洞穴要小心一點。

column1: You are atop the mesa. It is flat to the west.
column2: 你在台地頂端，西邊是一片平地。

column1: You are at the west side of a cliff area.
column2: 你在懸崖區域的西側。

column1: No good will come of that.
column2: 這麼做不會有好下場。

column2: 你看著懸崖，注意到一個小洞

column1: It lands with a pleasing thud.
column2: 它「咚」一聲落地，聲音還挺讓人滿意的。

column1: It was not known that you are a master of the rock! That was a fine effort.
column2: 沒想到你居然是丟石頭高手！這一手漂亮。

column1: It looks a lot like spinach.
column2: 這看起來很像菠菜。

column1: You tear off a piece of the plant.
column2: 你扯下一片植物。

column1: The Health Minister has determined that smoking is hazardous to your health.
column2: 衛生署長已經證實，吸菸有害健康。

column1: You take a whiff of the plant and find it to be a regrettable experience.
column2: 你聞了聞這株植物，這下可讓你後悔了。

column1: That is unreachable from here.
column2: 從這裡搆不到那個。

column1: You already have that.
column2: 你已經有那個了。

column1: You are not near that.
column2: 你不在那附近。

column1: There is a very large rock on the natural bridge.

column1: On the ground rests a large boulder.
column2: 地上擺著一塊大石頭。

column1: There are no rocks of note here.
column2: 這裡沒有什麼值得注意的石頭。

column1: You are following a path on the side of a cliff. It is rather desolate here.
column2: 你沿著懸崖邊的小路前進，這裡相當荒涼。

column1: You are in an area almost entirely surrounded by cliffs. A path winds its way along the sheer cliff to the left. It is not accessible from here.
column2: 你身處一處幾乎完全被懸崖包圍的地方。一條小路沿著左邊的峭壁蜿蜒而去，但從這裡走不過去。

column1: You are in an area almost entirely surrounded by cliffs. A path winds its way along the sheer cliff to the left. It is not accessible from here. There is a cave to the right.
column2: 你身處一處幾乎完全被懸崖包圍的地方。一條小路沿著左邊的峭壁蜿蜒而去，但從這裡走不過去。右邊有一個洞穴。

column1: A path winds its way along the sheer cliff to the left. It is not accessible from here.
column2: 一條小路沿著左邊的峭壁蜿蜒而去，但從這裡走不過去。

column1: You are walking along a path high above the ground.
column2: 你正走在一條高懸於地面之上的小路。

column1: You are at the southwest edge of a mesa. It is very desolate here.
column2: 你在台地的西南邊緣，這裡非常荒涼。

column1: You are in a desert cliff area. There is a natural land bridge in the distance.
column2: 你在沙漠懸崖區，遠處有一座天然地橋。

column1: It looks a lot like spinach.
column2: 這看起來很像菠菜。

column1: You plant your teeth in the strange plant and take a large bite, only to find it tastes exquisitely bad. If you had your choice, you would choose any form of death over a meal of this.
column2: 你一口咬進這株奇怪的植物，狠狠地咬了一大口，結果發現味道糟糕到極點。如果讓你選，你寧願死也不要再吃一口這種東西。

column1: You are in a desert cliff area.
column2: 你在沙漠懸崖區。

column1: Fortunately for you, the path here is not far above the ground. Your suffering is limited to a dull pain in the hindquarters.
column2: 算你走運，這裡的小路離地面不高，你頂多只是屁股隱隱作痛。

column1: The cave interior now features a lovely new Jagged Metal/Liberated Entrails motif. The stench? Whew! Not even an all-text adventure would attempt that description.
column2: 洞穴內部現在多了一種嶄新的「鋸齒鐵片／內臟四散」風格裝潢。至於那股臭味？呼！就連純文字冒險遊戲也不敢形容那有多恐怖。
